mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) below 3% reduce discount rates for equity cash flows and increase equity attractiveness relative to fixed income, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL rise above 255.5 signals accelerating inflation, triggering central bank tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 255.5 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous UNRATE > 3.7 and PAYEMS < 151308.0 signal labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 3.7 and PAYEMS < 151308.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
